author: North
name: VoiceTranscribe
short: Automatic multilingual Discord voice note transcription and optional English translation.
description: Automatically replies to native Discord voice notes with original-language transcription and, for non-English audio, an optional English translation. Uses multilingual faster-whisper and optionally local Argos text-translation models; no paid API. Per-server opt-in and controls, owner-adjustable recognition model and decoding speed.
install_msg: Update or load this cog, then use [p]vt on and [p]vt translate on. It uses the offline multilingual Whisper base model by default, downloaded once on first use. For speed try [p]vt speed fast; owners may use [p]vt model tiny or small. Optional Argos translation packs are documented in the cog README. Requires Message Content Intent.
end_user_data_statement: No end-user audio or transcript history is stored persistently by the cog. Voice-note audio is saved to a temporary file and deleted after processing; the original and translated text are posted in Discord and retained according to Discord/server policies. Speech recognition and translation run locally. Whisper model weights are downloaded from a provider on first use; optional Argos language packs require separate manual installation.
